title: All-hands Q3 2026 - Draft talking points & anticipated Q&A
content:
Draft - All-hands (Q3 2026) talking points and anticipated Q&A

Goal:
- Align the company on priorities for Q3 (reliability, Dedicated customer onboarding, Redwood Optimize rollout)
- Celebrate wins (new enterprise logos, latency improvements, cost reductions)
- Surface risks and asks (hiring focus, support coverage, rollout resources)

Agenda (15-20 min total):
1) Opening (CEO) - 3 min: topline, gratitude
2) Product & GTM highlights - 6 min: launches, metrics, customer examples
3) Platform & SRE update - 3 min: reliability/latency SLOs, incidents
4) People & hires - 2 min: key roles, org notes
5) Closing & ask - 1-2 min
6) Live Q&A - remainder

Talking points (concise bullets for speaker notes):
- Topline: Q2 finished strong - revenue +42% YoY (need to confirm with Finance; placeholder). Net new ARR from three enterprise deals (two Dedicated, one Private).
- Product wins:
  - Redwood Optimize v1.3 launched in early July: intelligent batching recommendations and quantization profiles for T4/RTX customers. Early customers report 18-25% token cost reduction. (link to internal report)
  - EU region GA: production traffic in eu-west-1 now active, reducing median latency for EU customers by ~30ms.
  - Hosted API: added streaming stability fixes that reduced client-side stalls by ~40% in canary tests.
- Dedicated / Private:
  - Onboarding pipeline: 6 customers in the queue for Dedicated (3 expected to onboard this quarter). Private pilot expanded to two regulated customers with air-gapped requirement - ops work in progress.
- Reliability & performance:
  - Median 95th-token latency improved by 12% since March after kernel selection improvements and KV cache tuning.
  - Recent P0 incident (June 18) root cause: autoscaling misconfiguration + a hot-shard on model X. Fix deployed; follow-up mitigation: better shard balancing and autoscale test harness.
- People / hiring:
  - Hiring priorities: SRE (2 ICs), Serving Runtime (3 engineers focused on kernel/path optimizations), Solutions Eng (2 customer-facing hires).
  - Reminder: interview blitz next week - coordinators: Priya and Noah.
- Ask from org:
  - Help priority: documentation and runbooks for Dedicated onboarding (owners: Solutions Eng + Onboarding).
  - Support for Optimize launch: engineering to help triage early regressions; product to collect usage hooks and feedback prompts.

Customer anecdotes (brief):
- Enterprise A (finance): moved a high-throughput generation workload to Dedicated, saw 3x throughput improvement and predictable cost per token. Quote for slide: "Predictable throughput made our SLAs achievable" - Solutions Eng note.

Anticipated Q&A (prep answers; keep short):
Q: Are we changing pricing?
A: No broad pricing changes planned this quarter. Focus is on Optimize as a value driver; we will continue targeted pricing conversations for Dedicated commitments. (If pressed, defer to Finance / Pricing team - Priya).

Q: What happened with the June incident? Will this recur?
A: Root cause was autoscale policy + a hot-shard on a particular model. We've deployed a two-part mitigation: better shard balancing and automated autoscale tests. Short-term risk reduced; medium-term plan includes a probe system to detect shard hotspots early.

Q: How are we supporting enterprise onboarding (Dedicated/Private)?
A: We have a standardized onboarding checklist, a rotating Onboarding TPM, and solutions templates. Current bottleneck is SRE/infra capacity for bespoke networking in Private pilots - recruiting is targeted to that.

Q: Any headcount freeze or layoffs?
A: No. We are prioritizing hires in SRE, serving runtime, and customer-facing teams to accelerate onboarding and reliability.

Q: When will Optimize be generally available?
A: We plan a phased GA in late Q3 after extended canary with top customers and validating cost/quality regressions. Exact date TBD; product will send launch comms.

Notes to self / open items (scratchpad):
- TODO: Confirm Q2 revenue number with Finance (Priya) - placeholder +42% YoY.
- TODO: Get exact Dedicated customer names clearance for mention (legal/CS).
- TODO: Pull short quote from Solutions Eng for customer anecdote and confirm wording.
- Follow-up doc: publish post-all-hands one-pager with links to runbooks, onboarding checklist, and Optimize FAQ. Owner: Jamie + Priya.
- Confirm speaker order and timing with Exec assistant by 2026-07-14.

Tone notes for speaker:
- Keep it crisp, optimistic, and transparent. Call out wins but be clear about risks and asks. Use one short customer quote. Avoid deep technical jargon in the opening segment; reserve details for product breakout or docs.

Draft slide ideas (for comms team):
- Slide 1: Topline metrics (ARR change, new logos, NPS snippet)
- Slide 2: Product highlights (Optimize, EU region, streaming stability) - 3 bullets
- Slide 3: Reliability snapshot (SLOs, recent incident mitigations)
- Slide 4: People/hiring snapshot + org asks
- Slide 5: Customer wins (1-2 short quotes)
- Slide 6: Closing + where to find follow-up materials (internal Confluence link)

Rough timeline for comms:
- 7/12: finalize slide deck draft (this doc)
- 7/14: speaker run-through
- 7/20: all-hands (date tentative)
- 7/21: publish follow-up one-pager and links
